AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION

Notice Under Section 7

My No.: බල/2/1/04/20. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2001/PC/382. The notice is hereby given by the Sub section (1) in the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the government intends to acquire the below mentioned land/servitude for a public purpose.
The description of the land/servitude to be acquired-

The land named as Angi Achchigewatta which has been approximately extended in an extent of 0.0084 Hectare by the extension depicted as Lot Nos. 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10 and 11 under the preliminary plan No. G 4402 dated 31.12.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General and located in the Grama Niladhari Division-No.21,Galmangoda, Divisional Secretariat Division - Balapitiya of Galle District, Widening the Road by 12 feet up to the railway reservation from the land belonged to the person named as Neela which is situated in the Weerasinghe De silva Road.

My No.: බල/2/1/28. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 03J/91/E/202. THE notice is hereby given by the Sub section (1) in the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the government intends to acquire the below mentioned land/servitude for a public purpose.

The description of the land/servitude to be acquired- The land called as Angi Achchigewatta which has been extended in approximately in 0.2480 Hectare by the extension shown as Lot No. 01 in the preliminary plan No. G 4380 dated 27.09.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General and located in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 23, Maduwa, Divisional Secretariat Division Balapitiya of Galle District, acquiring for the playground of the G/Maduwa Junior School.
01. Lot No. 01
Name of the Land: Angi Achchigewatta; Extent: 0.2480 Hectare.

North: Thanabotuwawaththa claimed by W. Jinasena De Silva and others and Delmulewaththa claimed by W. Martin De Silva and others; East: Road; South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Linthotawaththa claimed by N. Lasinton and others.

The all claimants and people who have ownerships or other relation to the aforementioned land/servitude themselves or the people who are authorized by their documents should be appeared before me at 2.00 p. m. on 15.05.2019, at the Divisional Secretariat - Balapitiya.

Further, the nature of their ownerships related to the mentioned land, details on the facts for claiming compensation regarding the acquiring that land, the amount of compensation and the way it was calculated shall be received to me by duly completed two copies prior to the date of 08.05.2019. B. P. S. ANURADHI, Divisional Secretary, Balapitiya. 27th February, 2019.
